moresteam.configuration.title: More Steam
moresteam.configuration.steamDurationMul: How much longer bogeys release steam after a train stops. 1.0 is Create's own duration.
moresteam.configuration.idleSteam.toolti: Whether the bogeys of a standing train keep letting off small puffs of steam.
moresteam.configuration.idleSteamInterva: Average number of ticks between idle puffs, per bogey. Lower means more steam.
